authorityRule: Intersect host/session/project/task grants. Guided design decisions require human authority; YOLO delegates design choices only. Token presence/tool availability never creates new permission.
realmRule: Every command targets exactly one owning SQLite realm: project state or private local profile configuration. Personal settings events have null projectId/runId and a profile-specific databaseEpoch; namespace idempotency by stable profileId. Project exports exclude private profiles. Cross-realm settings reads are resolved into an immutable run snapshot; no distributed transaction is required or claimed.
batchAtomicity: Independent per-item semantic outcomes, with all applied local results plus rejected-item outcomes and the batch receipt committed in one SQLite transaction. Unexpected storage failure rolls back the outer transaction.
externalEffectRule: Persist intent before dispatch; perform external call outside transaction; record actual result. Unknown remote outcome keeps liability unresolved. Rebuild/replay never reexecutes a paid effect.

blobTransport.prepare: blob.prepare returns a receipt referring to a principal/scope-bound BlobStagingReceipt and enforces discovered byte limits before allocation.
blobTransport.upload: Authenticated streaming PUT to the adapter staging resource, or a scoped CLI/MCP host-file reader, writes only the allocated staging object. Do not put binary bodies, remote URLs, filesystem paths, bearer tokens or signed URLs in the domain envelope. A same-staging-ID replay is a full replacement allowed only before verification and only for the same declared digest/length; concurrent writes acquire an exclusive lease and conflict.
blobTransport.verify: blob.verify streams hash/size/media validation and flushes the object before recording verified. artifact.register/import_prepare/theme.install accept only a matching verified receipt in their authorized scope.
blobTransport.download: Authenticated digest/version resource reads are separately scoped; no filesystem path traversal or unrestricted URL proxy. Metadata does not itself authorize byte access.
blobTransport.retention: Uncommitted staging expires under an owned age policy; no referenced artifact or event snapshot is reclaimed as staging.

transportPolicy.canonicalNames: Adapter-neutral names above. Existing documented ui-design CLI/MCP/OMP aliases remain translated wrappers; exact new public route/tool aliases are versioned in the implementation API manifest.
transportPolicy.http: Authenticate first; schema/field errors 400, authenticated forbidden 403, absent scoped entity 404, revision/idempotency/dependency conflicts 409, conditional HTTP header mismatch 412 when used, unavailable 503. Domain codes remain stable.
transportPolicy.mcp: Report shared structured receipt/error within supported MCP result envelopes; do not invent host capabilities.
transportPolicy.cli: Machine JSON output contains the same receipt/error; documented exit codes distinguish failure from success. Human text may summarize but cannot change semantics.
